annotations.text:
Petrol is settled. This page varies only STRUCTURE - same palette, same IBM Plex Sans and Mono - so form is the single variable.

All three drop the card-in-a-card habit, which is the part that reads as generic. Rulework replaces boxes with a gutter and hairlines. Console makes the row the unit and sets surfaces inset instead of raised. Plate uses one unbroken surface and lets scale carry the hierarchy.

Each names what it costs at the bottom - none of them is free.

Pick one, or say which parts of two you want combined.

Settled: PETROL.

The five candidates stay here as the record of what was compared. Each changed hue, chroma, form and type together; all 27 contrast pairs pass in both appearances for every one of them.

The open question moved to the Form page.

These pages still show the Indigo values. They get recoloured to Petrol - and restructured to whichever form you pick - before any token is written.

Every contrast number on them is computed by tools/palette-report.mjs, not estimated.
